security_spec.violation_condition: In XiangShan RTL, when executing vsetvl or vsetivli with AVL exactly equal to VLMAX (i.e., the application-requested vector length exactly matches the hardware's maximum vector length for the current vtype configuration), the vector length CSR vl is written with ceil(AVL/2) or VLMAX instead of AVL. This occurs because the first branch comparison uses a strict-less-than (<) rather than less-or-equal (<=), so the AVL==VLMAX case falls through to the second branch and vl gets halved.
security_spec.summary: Off-by-one comparison in vsetvl/vsetivli VL computation: when AVL==VLMAX, vl is incorrectly set to ceil(AVL/2) instead of AVL, causing vector instructions to silently operate on only half the intended data elements.
